boundaryGroup.ticketRecipe: Allocate normally in ascending NN; tickets 4 through 24 when initialized from this exact base recipe
boundaryGroup.exact20Case: Separate fresh scenario creates NN=01..20 only; expected page length 20 and no continuation
boundaryGroup.oneCase: Separate query title-only unique marker or identity yields one row
boundaryGroup.stalePageCase: Read first page, commit a normal update, then use old continuation: 409 CURSOR_STALE; First page deliberately restarts without concatenation. Service restart also makes cursor stale.
boundaryGroup.contextMismatchCase: Use continuation with changed query (including case-only q), lane, owner, priority, archive mode or Research board: definite refusal, no fallback.

archiveJourney.clients: Run ordinary built browser and actual built CLI journeys on separate fresh scenarios; cross-read each committed mutation in the other client
archiveJourney.approval: card.edit existing approval invalidation on real unfinished-card archive/unarchive; Completed is terminal/read-only and both actions refuse, even equal flag
archiveJourney.noOp: Repeated current authorized archive or unarchive gives durable NOT_COMMITTED/NO_CHANGE without revision/history/activity bump; stale/invalid/unauthorized admission precedes no-op
archiveJourney.activity: A real commit uses existing activity semantics; archive exclusion does not erase actual last-activity metadata

evidenceCategories.ordinary: Named built-browser journey and actual executable CLI; positive cross-reads, bounds, counts and keyboard focus
evidenceCategories.injected: Named delayed/lost-response seams with immutable original and lookup; not native crash/power-loss proof
evidenceCategories.controlled: Malformed/stale continuation, denied authority, retained/removed comment and export/restore edges; not substitutes for positive ordinary journey
evidenceCategories.reuse: Exact prior candidate/source and narrow covered behavior; M02 evidence alone does not qualify find/archive
evidenceCategories.privateBinding: Future source/executable/staged assets/commands, alias-to-identity mapping, first failures/retests and cleanup belong in private evidence

searchContract.filters: AND lane exact label, owner omitted any/unassigned/canonical UUID, explicit priority exact P0..P5, archive active(default)/archived/all
searchContract.page: Fixed20 partial summary rows; Next results and First page only. Authenticated bounded process-ephemeral cursor binds board/incarnation/revision/exact q/default-resolved typed filters/last sort key; current read right rechecked.
searchContract.transport: GET /api/v1/boards/{boardUUID}/cards?q&lane&owner&priority&archive&cursor; separate generated summary DTO, no full content/history
searchContract.order: P0..P5, ticket ascending, canonical UUID ascending
searchContract.cli: card search --query TEXT --lane LABEL --owner UUID|unassigned --priority P0..P5 --archive active|archived|all --cursor TOKEN; all flags optional, no query means all subject to filters
searchContract.query: q <=1024 UTF-8 bytes, whitespace preserved, empty all; ToLower literal substring current title/description/retained comments OR exact canonical UUID/positive decimal ticket optional leading #
searchContract.queryEcho: Exact validated original q; default-resolved lane/owner/priority/archive. Go simple lowercasing is authoritative matching only, never JS normalization. Cursor binds exact q including case; case-only changes require fresh First page.

archiveContract.mutation: Existing card.edit payload archived:true or archived:false only; mixed edit fields refuse; omission retained in legacy semantic fingerprint
archiveContract.policy: Existing edit right/revisions; Completed archive/unarchive refuse before no-op; other unfinished archived-card operation admission unchanged, start remains refused
archiveContract.boardRead: Existing GET board/BoardRead JSON remains COMPLETE archived-inclusive source snapshot, canonical ticket order and graph reference closure. No archive query. Default UI lanes/human-readable CLI board projection hide archived locally; Archive status selects visible mode.
archiveContract.compatibility: Same new candidate export/restore plus frozen legacy card.edit fingerprint compatibility check
archiveContract.cli: card archive|unarchive CARD-UUID --input FILE are thin aliases to card.edit with the matching archived flag
archiveContract.listing: M03.02 adds GET /boards/{boardUUID}/cards empty q/archive/cursor only and card list [--archive active|archived|all] [--cursor TOKEN], fixed 20 partial CardSearchRead scope card-search summaries without reference graph; M03.03 expands same route to full filters and card search. Both default active.
